glosses: circumstance (a fact or condition that affects an event or situation)
circumstances (the way things are at a given moment)
solemnity; formality (the quality of being deeply serious)

examples.en: I won't go under any circumstances.

examples.text: Em que circunstâncias morreu seu primeiro marido?
examples.en: How did your first husband die?

examples.text: Você deve se adaptar às circunstâncias.
examples.en: You have to adapt to circumstances.

examples.text: Eu não iria sob nenhuma circunstância.
examples.en: I wouldn't go under any circumstances.
